Title: Suresh's Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 36 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 29 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Pallavi - 64 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Anita stands in the courtyard. Suresh and Pallavi stand near her.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Anita washes clothes in a bucket.]

Anita: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "What a nice place."

[Suresh's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Suresh: "I'm ready!"

[Suresh's car crashes into a pole.]

Suresh: "Hmm, I see."

[A dog runs in front of Suresh's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Pallavi: "Hmm, I see."

[Suresh loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Pallavi (softly): "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Suresh stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's begin."

[Suresh drinks a beer.]

Pallavi: "One more time!"

[Suresh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Pallavi (excited): "Let's see."

Scene 4: The terrace - Day

[Anita stands on the terrace. Pallavi and Suresh stand near her.]

Pallavi: "Anita, look over here."

[Anita hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Pallavi: "I really enjoyed today."
